messages:
jordan: Heads-up: proposing a targeted unpin tomorrow 01:00 UTC for runtime 2.8 -> 2.9 on non-quant hosts only. Need ops escape hatch for quant hosts.

maya: Good call. Quant hosts still need 2.8 kernels. We'll need a hostname-level pin.

felix: I'll add a host-affinity rule in pinlist. Suggest we mark model tag 'quant-v2' -> pinned 2.8.

deploybot: Scheduled change window 1716961200 (01:00 UTC). Canary: can-quant-skip 5% for 15m. Plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m holds.

jordan: Rollback criteria: errors >1% for 5m OR any OOM on quant hosts -> immediate rollback and sticky-pin.

ops-bot: We'll auto-sticky-pin hostnames that emit OOM or model-eval regressions. Alerting to #eng-oncall configured.

sdk-team: Reminder: SDK 2.5 injects legacy binding; if customers on <2.5 we should keep embeddings pinned until uptake.

maya: Decision: unpin generate/chat on non-quant hostnames. Keep embed and rerank pinned for 48h. Hostname pins applied for quant-v2.

deploybot: Canary metrics at 12m: errors 0.3%, p95 +10% overall, quant hosts unchanged.

felix: Enforced host pins applied. Added INF-5005 to improve hostname->model mapping in inventory.

jordan: Proceeding to 25%. Support notified with rollback playbook.

ops-bot: Sticky-pin thresholds: OOM or eval-regression. Also tagging telemetry with "sdk_client_version" for correlation.

deploybot: 25% hold metrics stable. Scheduling full rollout in 2h.

maya: I'll draft release note blurb: "Runtime 2.9 rollout for non-quant workloads. Quantized model hostnames remain on 2.8 to preserve correctness."

jordan: Post-roll action items: INF-5006 add e2e that compares embedding outputs between 2.8 and 2.9 on quant testset; INF-5007 add automated pinlist audit.

felix: Thanks team. If SDK 2.5 adoption accelerates we can shorten embed pin window.

jordan: Closing thread  will update release notes after final.
